usedFor: Ploomes holds the deals and contacts, and Hastewire makes text sound natural through “Humanize Text” after “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “Create Deal” in Ploomes, then “Humanize Text” in Hastewire
bestTemplate.why: A new deal carries text worth smoothing, and the action rewrites it to sound natural.

watchOut: “Deal Updated” fires on every edit, so “Humanize Text” can run twice on the same deal.
